description: This file defines the PdfObjectStream class, which models an object stream containing compressed objects within a PDF document. It includes constructors for creating streams from a document or an existing dictionary, methods for reading object IDs and offsets within the stream, and nested classes for associated keys. The class is part of the PdfSharp.Pdf.Advanced namespace and leverages logging, input/output, and PDF parsing functionalities.

classes.name: PdfObjectStream
classes.description: Represents a PDF object stream containing compressed objects, providing methods for initialization and extracting object IDs with offsets.

classes.name: PdfObjectStream.Keys
classes.description: Defines the dictionary keys specific to PdfObjectStream, including required and optional attributes for object stream identification and extension.

methods.name: PdfObjectStream
methods.description: Constructor initializing a new object stream from a PDF document.

methods.name: PdfObjectStream
methods.description: Internal constructor creating an object stream from an existing dictionary and parser.

methods.name: ReadObjectIDsWithOffsets
methods.description: Reads and returns all object IDs and their read positions within the object stream.
